objectives.title: Governance bodies that decide
objectives.statement: Set up governance bodies, such as a council, an architecture board and an ethics committee, that make timely decisions and see that they are carried out.
objectives.risk: Decisions not made or not enforced
tiers: Experiments need no body's decision.
Tier 2 decisions are delegated to named reviewers.
Tier 3 decisions go to the architecture board or the ethics committee within a set time.
Tier 4 decisions go to the governance council, with the executive sponsor present.
objectives.evidence: The bodies' charters, their minutes and decision times.

objectives.title: A named owner for every agent
objectives.statement: Give every agent a named person or organization that answers for it, with clear responsibilities.
objectives.metric: Share of agents with a named owner
tiers: The builder owns the experiment.
A named owner is recorded in the catalog before release.
The owner has a named deputy, and ownership is confirmed at each review date.
Ownership sits with a senior manager who reports on the agent to the governance council.
objectives.evidence: The owner and deputy in the catalog, and the confirmations at review.

objectives.title: Who decides, acts and is informed
objectives.statement: Write down, for each governance activity, who decides, who acts, who is consulted and who is informed.
objectives.metric: Share of governance activities with assigned roles
tiers: The builder decides and acts for the experiment.
Roles are written down for release and incident decisions.
Roles are written down for every activity on this site that applies to the agent.
Roles are reviewed each year by the governance council.
objectives.evidence: The responsibility matrix and its review date.

objectives.title: Executive training
objectives.statement: Train executives in agent governance, so that their decisions on strategy rest on understanding.
tiers: No training is required for an experiment.
Sponsors of Tier 2 agents complete the introduction.
Sponsors of Tier 3 agents complete the full course.
Members of the governance council complete the full course and a yearly refresher.

objectives.title: Builder training
objectives.statement: Train the people who build agents in secure, compliant development practice.
tiers: Builders read the sandbox rules.
Builders complete the development standards course.
Builders of Tier 3 agents complete the security course.
Builders of Tier 4 agents are certified and refresh their training each year.

objectives.title: User training
objectives.statement: Train the people who use agents in proper use, so that agents are neither misused nor wasted.
objectives.risk: Misuse or little use of agents
tiers: No training is required for an experiment.
Users get a short guide before first use.
Users of Tier 3 agents complete training on what the agent may and may not do.
Users who approve acts for a Tier 4 agent complete training on what they are approving.
objectives.evidence: Training records and the guides issued.

objectives.title: Liaisons in the business
objectives.statement: Keep liaisons between governance and each business unit, so that governance stays in step with the work.
objectives.risk: Business units out of touch with governance
tiers: No liaison is required for an experiment.
Each business unit with production agents has a named liaison.
Liaisons meet governance each month.
Liaisons report on their unit's agents to the governance council.
objectives.evidence: The list of liaisons and meeting records.

objectives.title: Change management
objectives.statement: Manage the change governance brings to people's work, so that it is adopted rather than worked around.
tiers: No requirement applies to an experiment.
New governance steps are announced with guidance.
New governance steps are piloted and adjusted before they become mandatory.
Adoption is measured and reported to the governance council.

objectives.title: Communication
objectives.statement: Tell the people affected what governance requires of them, in plain language.
objectives.risk: People who do not know the rules
tiers: The sandbox rules are published.
Governance requirements are published where builders and owners work.
Changes to requirements are sent to affected owners before they take effect.
Awareness is surveyed each year.

objectives.title: Feedback on governance
objectives.statement: Collect feedback on governance itself from the people it affects, and act on it.
tiers: Builders can send feedback on the sandbox rules.
Feedback is collected after each review.
Feedback is tracked to an action or a reason for no action.
Feedback trends feed the yearly framework review in Continuous improvement.
objectives.evidence: The feedback log and actions taken.
